# The Minish Cap for macOS 1.1.1

A fix of 1.1: saving a state failed ("cannot save the state: _sSlideEnd.1 is not in the save state pointer
map"). Save states work again.

Everything else is as in 1.1 (widescreen: Settings → Display → View; see the 1.1 release notes).

## Download

`TheMinishCap-1.1.1-macos-universal.zip`: one app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs, macOS 12 Monterey or later.
It replaces 1.1. You need your own ROM of The Minish Cap (USA); the app is not signed by a registered developer,
so the first time open it with right-click → Open (the zip's `Read me first.txt` has the steps).
